question.text: The USDINR spot rate is 83.00 and the 1-month forward premium is 15 paise. What is the annualized forward premium percentage?

explanation.text: The Logic: The 1-month forward premium of 15 paise equals INR 0.15. Annualised premium = (Premium / Spot) x (12 / n) x 100 = (0.15 / 83.00) x 12 x 100 = 2.1687%, or about 2.17%. The Trap: Option B (0.18%) is the 1-month premium expressed as a percentage without annualisation. Option C (1.80%) miscomputes the annualised figure. Option D (18.07%) incorrectly divides 15 by 83 instead of 0.15 by 83. Note: Distributor-style and test-frequency wording removed; explanation tied to forward premia in rupees and percentage terms.
